about.lead: Born in Agôè-Démakpoè, TBS has been equipping the great moments of Togolese life for over ten years.
about.p1: What began as a few batches of chairs and tableware lent to the neighbourhood has become a stock of more than 900 items, maintained piece by piece in our warehouses. Today we serve families, caterers, hotels, institutions and companies across Greater Lomé.
about.p2Intro: The company is now organised into four divisions:
about.p2Equipements: for the supply of materials and equipment,
about.p2Events: for reception equipment rental and event management,
about.p2Etudes: for studies and advisory services, and
about.p3: Our work does not stop at delivery: we advise on volumes and specifications, install and commission, coordinate suppliers and follow up after the event. One point of contact, from the first call to the last box loaded.

equipements.title: From the request
steps: Statement of needs
Specifications, quantities, technical requirements. We frame the request with your teams.
Costed offer
Sourcing from our suppliers, detailed technical and financial offer, committed lead times.
Delivery & installation
Transport, joint acceptance, installation and commissioning on site.
Warranty & follow-up
Manufacturer warranty, parts, maintenance and consumable restocking.
equipements.footnote: TBS Distribution S.A.R.L also responds to public and private consultations and tenders: administrative file up to date, technical and financial offer, standardised invoices.

events.title: Rent in
steps: Tell us everything
Date, venue, number of guests, the look you want. A ten-minute conversation is enough.
Receive the quote
Detailed inventory, floor plan and firm price within 24 hours.
We set up
Delivery, assembly and set-up completed before the guests arrive.
We take it all back
Dismantling and collection after the party. You put nothing away.

etudes.title: Client-side
steps: Client-side project support
Technical and administrative follow-up of your projects, from specifications to acceptance of the works or equipment.
Tender file preparation
Assembling tender files, administrative documents, technical and financial offers.
General trade & sourcing
Local and import sourcing, group purchasing, general supplies for institutions and companies.

agro.title: From the field
steps: Support for cooperatives
Structuring, group purchasing and technical training for members.
Projects & funders
Supply of equipment for farming projects financed by donors and NGOs.
Equipment maintenance
Parts, servicing and refurbishment of small equipment and processing units.
